newsitem.title: CANADA: Geomaque to merge with Milagro.
newsitem.headline: Geomaque to merge with Milagro.

text.p: Geomaque Explorations Ltd said on Monday it signed a formal binding agreement with Milagro Minerals Inc to merge operations of the two companies, with Milagro shareholders receiving one Geomaque share for every four shares of Milagro held.
Geomaque said the deal was subject to approval of Milagro shareholders.

On completion of the deal, the assets of Milagro and Geomaque will be merged and operated by the current Geomaque management team, Geomaque said. It said no expansion of the board of directors was planned.

Milagro's principal asset is a 100 percent-owned, 10,000 hectare concession in northwestern Honduras, which incorporates gold and base metal targets including the Vueltas del Rio gold deposit, whose drill-indicated resource of about 500,000 ounces of gold was previously identified.
Geomaque said it estimated a mineable reserve of more than 250,000 ounces of gold would be develped at Vueltas del Rio.
Geomaque is producing gold from its 100 percent-owned San Francisco Mine in Mexico and exploring for gold in Mexico and West Africa.
